entries.title: Psalms 49:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm.>> Hear this, all ye peoples; give ear, all inhabitants of the world:

entries.title: Psalms 49:2
segments: Both men of low and men of high degree, rich and poor alike.

entries.title: Psalms 49:3
segments: My mouth shall speak wisdom, and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding:

entries.title: Psalms 49:4
segments: I will incline mine ear to a parable, I will open my riddle upon the harp.

entries.title: Psalms 49:5
segments: Wherefore should I fear in the days of adversity, [when] the iniquity of my supplanters encompasseth me? --

entries.title: Psalms 49:6
segments: ¶They depend upon their wealth, and boast themselves in the abundance of their riches. ...

entries.title: Psalms 49:7
segments: None can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him,

entries.title: Psalms 49:8
segments: (For the redemption of their soul is costly, and must be given up for ever,)

entries.title: Psalms 49:9
segments: That he should still live perpetually, [and] not see corruption.

entries.title: Psalms 49:10
segments: For he seeth that wise men die; all alike, the fool and the brutish perish, and they leave their wealth to others.

entries.title: Psalms 49:11
segments: Their inward thought is, that their houses are for ever, their dwelling-places from generation to generation: they call the lands after their own names.

entries.title: Psalms 49:12
segments: Nevertheless, man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.

entries.title: Psalms 49:13
segments: This their way is their folly, yet they that come after them delight in their sayings. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 49:14
segments: Like sheep are they laid in Sheol: Death feedeth on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their comeliness shall be for Sheol to consume, that there be no habitation for them.

entries.title: Psalms 49:15
segments: ¶But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol: for he will receive me. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 49:16
segments: Be not afraid when a man becometh rich, when the glory of his house is increased:

entries.title: Psalms 49:17
segments: For when he dieth, he shall carry nothing away; his glory shall not descend after him.

entries.title: Psalms 49:18
segments: Though he blessed his soul in his lifetime, --and men will praise thee when thou doest well to thyself, --

entries.title: Psalms 49:19
segments: It shall go to the generation of his fathers: they shall never see light.

entries.title: Psalms 49:20
segments: Man that is in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish.
